benchmarkCompile.diagnostic: The profile-wide source list included src/Test/JsonDecoding.purs and src/Test/JsonTypedAst.purs, which import Argonaut and PBO modules absent from the benchmark profile.

b8xApplication.diagnostic: After the test summary, spec-node persistResults initialized Data.Argonaut.Core.fromNumber and the generated module contained a missing-FFI stub: FFI not implemented: Data.Argonaut.Core.fromNumber.
b8xApplication.cause: b8x commit cef49ef0 (11 October 2026) removed the application-maintained F# overrides bak/spago.d/fs/p/argonaut-core/src/Data/Argonaut/{Core,Parser}.fs. The current checkout therefore has no implementation for the persistence path.
b8xApplication.resolution: Restored those two overrides, byte-for-byte from b8x parent 0f375a9469c92939583b7d1a831e6895088c24b0, into the isolated workspace only. Regenerated, rebuilt and reran. Live b8x inputs were not modified.

oldBundleBuild.diagnostic: The detached 0fddee1 worktree's relative overrides ../sharpurs-st and ../sharpurs-unsafe-coerce did not exist beside the private worktree.
oldBundleBuild.resolution: Added private symlinks to the live sibling sources and rebuilt. The bundle uses the same PBO 40d759e as the final compiler.
